(1 comment)
uncaught throws.

I've made a comment on this helper function to document that it throws.

The 2 usages of it in the EMConfig constructor are intended to not be caught since the constructor itself also throws on error.

For a non-throwing way to construct it, `fromJson` can be used. I documented that as the *preferred* function and keeping the throwing one to avoid verbosity/workarounds in testcases.

Let me know if you still prefer this function to not throw, but it will result in extra wrapper code to re-throw in the constructor.

Alternatively we can model it as 'nothing throws' depending on your preference.
nullptr dereference

`getConfigProp` does not return `nullptr` and instead throws. The exception is propagated to whoever calls the `EMConfig` constructor.

I added doc comment to both these functions explaining that they throw.

Also changed `getConfigProp` to return a value rather than a pointer.
Thanks for reviewing even WIP patches!
Haven't made it through everything
Let me know in case you want the tests as separate patch 👍
This is the Logging you've removed now?

yep, forgot to update this patch when it got merged.

Updated it now since `Logging` property is no longer required, we can drop a bunch of code here as well 👍

I have changed it here to `std::expected<void, std::string>` to capture the error message which could be simpler since it's just an internal API for this file.

> Do we think we're getting RVO invoked here?

I was not super concerned about optimizations on this parsing code. 
This function is only called around 2 times for each config file.

But happy to make changes here and there if someone knows a better way / algorithm.

However all of that is only ideas for the future.
